name: knot_memory_store
description: Store a cognitive memory, learning, or architectural insight into the Knot Swarm Memory Palace (SurrealDB cognitive graph). Supports optional artifact closet archiving (PocketBase).

artifact_content.description: Optional raw file content, code diff, or execution log to archive to PocketBase.

artifact_name.description: Optional name if archiving large payload / diff to PocketBase closet.

content.description: Detailed markdown explanation, rationale, or solution.

importance.description: Importance weight (default: 1.0; higher weights resist decay).

tags.description: Categorical tags for filtering and indexing.

title.description: Concise summary title of the memory nugget.
